title: File Card startup restore preference
completionRule: This is an explicit new File Card > More control. It is complete only when the canonical startup preference is persisted, restores no book while disabled, and rolls the menu state back when persistence fails.

unsupportedNodes.replacement: The reviewed generated Svelte/OXC scaffold has no startup restore control. Add one named checkbox to the existing File Card More menu without altering the legacy menu hierarchy.

sourceUiInventory.title: File Card More menu startup restore checkbox
acceptanceItems: Visible in File Card More only

items.title: File Card More menu control
items.targetContract: Expose exactly one named checkbox in File Card > More. Do not add it to the shared Library presentation menu.
items.notes: New control requested after the legacy migration; it deliberately reuses the existing More menu density and checkbox semantics.

items.title: Canonical startup preference
items.targetContract: Read and write [nodes.neoview.startup].restore_last_book through the authenticated runtime config DTO; default true and no browser-local duplicate state.
items.notes: The startup section follows the Reader config section protocol and TOML merge writer.

items.title: Restore only after configuration enables it
items.targetContract: Wait for the configuration response before requesting startup state, preserve explicit and external targets, abort a pending restore when disabled, and never restore merely because the user enables the checkbox during an active session.
items.notes: Startup state remains read-only data from the existing recent-history store.
